title: Apple's Future Computer: The Knowledge Navigator
summary: Apple's late-1980s Knowledge Navigator concept video, produced under John Sculley, showing a professor using a tablet-like device with a conversational software agent. It envisions hypertext, touchscreens and voice assistants.
why: HN cites it as an early vision of personal software agents and AI assistants, and as a fun retro look at predicted computing.

quote.text: These are always fun to watch.
